entities.name: Enez
entities.description: City on the Craggy Coast of southern Jamuraa on Dominaria, at the southern end of the Great Wall.

entities.name: Craggy Coast
entities.description: Rugged stretch of coastline in southern Jamuraa marked by cliffs and fortified settlements.

entities.name: Great Wall
entities.description: Ancient wall that protects the Craggy Coast region from inland threats.

entities.name: Bryce
entities.description: City friendly with Enez; site of the Battle of Bryce.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Leader who sent requests for aid to the coastal cities during Johan's War.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Emperor whose rise threatened the coastal cities; his empire crumbled after his death.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: War in which Johan sought to subjugate Jamuraa's coastal cities.

entities.name: Battle of Palmyra
entities.description: Battle to which Enez sent many warriors.

events.summary: After the Battle of Bryce, Hazezon Tamar asks the coastal cities for aid, warning of subjugation by Emperor Johan.
events.quote: Hazezon Tamar sent out requests for aid from the other coastal cities

events.summary: Enez answers the call and sends many warriors to fight at the Battle of Palmyra.
events.quote: Enez responded to Hazezon's call to arms, sending many warriors to fight in the Battle of Palmyra

relations.note: Enez is a city on the Craggy Coast.
relations.quote: Enez is a city on the Craggy Coast of southern Jamuraa

relations.note: Enez has friendly relations with Bryce.
relations.quote: has friendly relations with nearby Bryce

relations.note: Enez answered his call to arms.
relations.quote: Enez responded to Hazezon's call to arms
